newsitem.title: USA: Great Western says deal to be closed quickly.
newsitem.headline: Great Western says deal to be closed quickly.

text.p: Great Western Financial Corp said H.F. Ahmanson's presentation Monday before investors was a desparate attempt to win over investors and it remains confident its merger with Washington Mutual Savings Bank will be consummated quickly.
"Ahmanson's presentation was a desperate and hollow attempt to justify what continues to be an inferior merger proposal and a losing proposition," a Great Western spokesman said.
"We remain committed to the agreement with (WAMU) and we're confident it will be consummated quickly," he said.
Earlier, Ahmanson chief executive officer Charles Rinehart said that Ahmanson's bid was financially superior and more credible than Washington Mutual's.
Ahmanson said Washington Mutual's deal would be permanently dilutive and would not produce the revenue enchancements the companies have claimed.
